name: alt-text
desc: Free, open-source alt text generator for Windows — local vision models write image descriptions in batch. 100 MB portable, offline, MIT.
features: ✅ **Local vision captions** — a vision-language model describes each image on your machine, no upload
✅ **Length styles** — short WCAG-style alt, social caption and detailed description modes per batch
✅ **Context hints** — label the batch product, food or chart and the wording follows that register
✅ **Batch folders** — hundreds of images walked and captioned into a filename-to-text CSV
✅ **Edit pass** — fix wording in a grid before export, with keyboard-only movement
✅ **HTML snippet export** — img tags with alt attributes ready to paste into a site
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, vision model downloads separately, offline after that, MIT
compare: | Feature | **alt-text** | ChatGPT vision | Alt-text cloud APIs | Hand writing |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Free tier | Paid per call | Your hours |
| Images stay local | **Yes** | Upload | Upload | Yes
| Batch folder with CSV | **Yes** | No | API only | No
| Length style presets | **Yes** | Prompted | Prompted | Manual
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Browser | Cloud only | N/A
faqQ: generate alt text for many images offline for accessibility compliance?
faqA: Accessibility guidelines require alt text on every image, and cloud vision APIs bill per call while uploading the entire library. alt-text captions folders locally with per-platform styles and exports a CSV or HTML snippets. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline.
s1: Dark grid (#121417, green #16A34A): image thumbnails with caption fields beneath, style dropdown reading detailed, progress chip showing 143 of 400 described.
s2: Edit pass: focused caption expanded with keyboard hints, context hint chip reading product photos, quality note on one low-confidence caption in amber.
s3: Export view: CSV preview with filename and alt columns, HTML snippet tab selected, toast reading snippets copied for 400 images.
